verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing and payments API platform, and a buyer could fairly ask whether it publishes source under an open license, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a public repository, source code, or an open-source license. The MCP server, API reference and Stage environment are hosted services, not open source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
